correctness.rationale: For \(n\ge3\) the maximal-outerplanar fan graph is explicitly defined. The matching complex splits along the apex spokes into a path matching complex and disjoint cones over joins of two path matching complexes. The 3-step path suspension recurrence is proved by a deletion/link cofiber sequence. Link residue classes, nullity by sphere connectivity, and the homotopy-equivalence endpoint inclusion give the exact integral wedge formula in each class; \(n=3\) is verified directly. The standalone checker independently reconstructs all 16 complete mod-two simplicial boundary complexes \(3\le n\le18\) (93,822 nonempty simplices) and checks signed Euler identities and link residue counts \(3\le n\le300\). Finite checks are expressly corroborative, not a replacement for the infinite homotopy proof.

value.rationale: Fan graphs \(K_1\vee P_n\) are canonical maximal outerplanar polygon triangulations. The 2024 general theorem leaves their dimensions and sphere multiplicities unspecified; this result determines the complete integral homotopy type for every size. The sharp three-class transition (\(q+1\), \(q\), \(2q+2\) spheres in distinct predictable dimensions) gives a complete natural invariant rather than an arbitrary finite slice or routine restatement. No equivariant representations or stronger maximal-outerplanar theorem are claimed.
